question: On the lecture's timeline, where do generative AI (artificial intelligence) and AI agents sit?

options.text: In a new era that began after deep learning ended
options.feedback: It is tempting to give generative AI its own box, but the lecture did not. Deep learning has not ended; generative models and agents are its newest chapter, built from the same kind of neural networks.

options.text: In the machine learning era, alongside random forests
options.feedback: Generative models do learn from data, which is why this sounds right. But they are deep neural networks, which puts them in the deep learning era rather than the earlier one of random forests and logistic regression.

options.text: In the expert systems era, because they follow written rules
options.feedback: A chat model can look as if it follows rules, but nobody wrote any rules for it. Expert systems were hand-built from human knowledge; a transformer learns everything from text.

options.text: At the leading edge of the deep learning era
options.feedback: Generative AI and agents are the red arrow at the far end of deep learning: the same kind of neural network, pushed further. That is the era this course lives in.
